column1: # Cabin command expansion: lights beyond ambient, HVAC modes, seat modes,
# navigation landmarks, ordering and media. Each row is
# Grader fields for these live in vehicle_semantics_expanded.tsv once measured;
# this file is the text source so a new voice can be rendered from it.
# Coverage rules this set is built around, from the product requirements:
#   - position words: 主驾 / 副驾 / 左后 / 右后 and the English driver/passenger
#     forms, because getting these backwards is the worst failure in a cabin
#   - control verbs: 调到 (set to an absolute value) against 调高/调低 (relative)
#     must both appear, since they take different downstream actions
#   - every device family named in the requirements gets at least two clips so a
#     single misrecognition does not look like a domain-wide gap
# --- lights: every lamp a car actually exposes, not just ambient ----------

column3: Turn on the front fog lights
Turn off the rear fog lights
Turn the reading light to the brightest
Turn off the dome light and the footwell lights
Set the ambient lights to ice blue

column1: # --- HVAC: modes, not just a temperature --------------------------------
# 调到 vs 调高 is the pair that matters: same device, opposite downstream act.

column3: Raise the driver temperature by two degrees
Set the air conditioning to twenty four degrees
Turn on the front windshield defrost
Turn on the rear window defog
Switch to the footwell airflow mode
Set the climate to automatic mode
Lower the passenger temperature by one degree

column1: # --- seats: position, heating, ventilation, massage, memory -------------

column3: 把右后座椅加热调到三档
Turn on the driver seat massage
Set the rear right seat heater to level three
Turn the seat ventilation to the highest level

column1: # --- windows and roof: the ambiguous phrasing the requirements call out --
# `降下来三指` and `开一条缝` are the vague ones: no number, no percent.

column3: 把主驾车窗降下来三指
Roll the driver window down three fingers
Open the passenger window a crack

column1: # Mixed script on purpose: a Chinese sentence with a Latin place name is the
# normal case for a cabin, and it is the boundary where `rear right` broke.

column3: 导航到上海虹桥火车站
Navigate to the nearest charging station
Navigate to Shanghai Hongqiao railway station

column1: # --- ordering: the coffee case the requirements name ---------------------

column3: 来一杯瑞幸的生椰拿铁
Get me a Luckin coconut latte

column1: # --- media: playback control, not just "play something" ------------------

column3: Turn the volume up a little
